prompt: Which messages have a 👍 reaction from someone who holds an admin role in the Test Workspace?
binding_note: The identifying route runs message → reaction → reacting user → that user's workspace-membership record → workspace: the reactor's admin role must be the role recorded on their membership in Test Workspace itself, not an admin role held in a different workspace or a plain member role in Test Workspace.

roles.facts: Test Workspace (team_id T01WORKSPACE) is the workspace the request is scoped to; it is the sole primary workspace most users belong to.
roles.reason: Identifies the workspace whose membership role must be checked for any candidate reactor.

roles.facts: Robert Walsh (U03ROBERT23) holds role=admin on his membership record in Test Workspace.
roles.reason: Establishes a genuine admin-in-Test-Workspace user whose reaction behavior is then tested for emoji match.

roles.reason: Reactor is a genuine Test Workspace admin, but the emoji condition fails.

obligations.name: admin_thumbsup_messages
obligations.description: Messages that received a 👍 reaction from a user whose workspace-membership record in Test Workspace shows role=admin; no such message exists given the seeded reactions.
obligations.scope: messages across all channels in Test Workspace bearing a 👍 reaction from a Test-Workspace-admin reactor

task_spec.text: Identify which messages carry a 👍 reaction from a user holding an admin role in Test Workspace, and report any found.

access_plan: Enumerate channels via conversations.list, pull message history with conversations.history, and inspect per-message reactions with reactions.get to find all 👍 reactions; for each reacting user, call users.info (scoped to Test Workspace) to read their workspace-membership role and confirm whether it is admin on that same workspace's membership record, rather than an admin role held elsewhere or a lesser role in Test Workspace.
